Title: Tanay and the Family

Cast

1. Tanay - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anjali - 40 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Kavya - 10 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
4. Aditi - 10 years, friend
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Anjali, Kavya and Aditi stand near him.]

Tanay: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Tanay slips and falls.]

Aditi: "Okay, Tanay."

[Tanay sneezes loudly.]

Tanay (surprised): "That's great!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Tanay stands in the living room. Anjali stands near him.]

Tanay: "Let's begin."

[Tanay lies down on the sofa.]

Tanay (softly): "Mom, look at this."

[Tanay sits down on a chair.]

Anjali: "Show me too!"

[Tanay flops down on the sofa.]

Anjali: "I'm ready!"

[Tanay sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Tanay: "Okay, Mom."

Scene 3: The terrace - Day

[Tanay stands on the terrace. Anjali and Aditi stand near him.]

Tanay: "So, here we are!"

[Tanay flies a kite on the terrace.]

Aditi: "That was such a fun day!"
